jobs.title: Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Deployment Engineer** to support the installation, commissioning, integration, and successful deployment of **AI-powered machine vision quality inspection systems** at customer manufacturing facilities.The candidate will work closely with AI, software, automation, electrical, and customer teams to ensure that vision inspection systems are installed correctly, validated against quality requirements, and perform reliably in production environments.**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and commission **AI-based machine vision inspection systems** at customer sites.
* Understand customer inspection requirements and translate them into deployment and system requirements.
* Set up and configure **industrial cameras, lenses, lighting, sensors, triggers, and edge computing systems**.
* Perform camera calibration, image acquisition setup, triggering, exposure, focus, and lighting adjustments.
* Deploy and configure trained **AI/ML computer vision models** for defect detection and quality inspection.
* Integrate vision systems with **PLCs, sensors, actuators, robots, conveyors, and other automation equipment**.
* Support communication protocols such as **Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profinet, TCP/IP, or similar industrial protocols**.
* Conduct system testing, validation, FAT/SAT, and production trials.
* Monitor inspection accuracy, false rejects, missed defects, response time, and overall system performance.
* Troubleshoot issues related to cameras, lighting, sensors, PLC signals, software, networking, and AI model performance.
* Perform on-site system tuning to achieve required inspection accuracy and production speed.
* Coordinate with AI/Software teams for model improvements, retraining, and deployment updates when required.
* Provide technical support during production ramp-up and post-deployment activities.
* Train customer operators and maintenance teams on system operation and basic troubleshooting.
* Prepare deployment reports, installation records, test reports, SOPs, and system handover documentation.
* Maintain deployment checklists, system configurations, software versions, and service records.
* Coordinate with customers, automation vendors, and internal engineering teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Travel to customer manufacturing sites across India as required.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer – LLM & Python
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled **AI/ML Engineer – LLM & Python** to join our growing AI team in Mohali. The ideal candidate should have strong Python development skills and hands-on experience building AI-powered applications using **Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, and modern AI frameworks**.

You will work on real-world AI solutions involving intelligent assistants, document processing, automation, AI agents, and LLM-powered applications. You will collaborate with developers, project managers, and product teams to design, develop, integrate, and optimize scalable AI solutions for clients across different industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using **Python and Generative AI technologies**.
* Build applications using LLMs such as **OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Qwen**, and other open-source models.
* Develop and optimize **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines for AI applications.
* Work with embeddings, semantic search, document processing, and vector databases.
* Build intelligent AI workflows and agents using frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen**, or similar technologies.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs and backend services for AI-powered applications.
* Integrate LLM APIs and third-party AI services into existing applications.
* Design effective prompts and improve response quality, accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Evaluate AI outputs and identify opportunities to reduce hallucinations and improve overall system performance.
* Work with structured and unstructured data to prepare information for AI and LLM applications.
* Optimize AI applications for **latency, scalability, reliability, and cost**.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across AI pipelines and backend services.
* Collaborate with software developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
* Document AI workflows, integrations, technical decisions, and development processes.
* Stay updated with advancements in **Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, NLP, and AI development frameworks**.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **1–4 years of professional experience** in AI/ML Engineering, Machine Learning, Python Development, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in **Python**.
* Hands-on experience working with **Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)**.
* Good understanding of **Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP fundamentals**.
* Practical experience with **Prompt Engineering**.
* Hands-on experience building or integrating **RAG applications**.
* Understanding of embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
* Experience with at least one LLM/AI framework such as **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar**.
* Experience integrating AI APIs such as **OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Hugging Face**.
* Good understanding of **REST APIs and backend development**.
* Familiarity with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar.
* Familiarity with **Git and version control systems**.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a cross-functional team.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building **AI Agents or Agentic AI workflows**.
* Knowledge of **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**.
* Experience with vector databases such as **Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, or Qdrant**.
* Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers and open-source LLMs.
* Experience with **PyTorch or TensorFlow**.
* Knowledge of LLM evaluation, guardrails, structured outputs, or function/tool calling.
* Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, or Django**.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized application deployment.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Basic understanding of **MLOps/LLMOps** and production AI deployment.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms such as **n8n, Make, or Zapier**.
* GitHub projects, AI/ML portfolio, or experience building AI prototypes and production applications.

**Why Join Us?**

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* Opportunity to work on **real-world Generative AI and LLM projects**.
* Exposure to the latest AI models, frameworks, agentic technologies, and automation tools.
* Opportunity to work on international client projects across different industries.
* Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment.
* Career growth opportunities in the rapidly evolving AI/ML domain.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Flexible working environment.
